module: Read access to the game's settings from Lua (both VMs). At load it reads /settings/defaults.json (definitions: each setting is an array whose element [2] is the default value), the file deprecated.json (renamed/obsolete settings), applies presets (units according to the OS language, platform file, internal values outside the shipping build), then getValues() merges defaults + cloud settings + local settings. This is what a mod queries with settings.getValue('key', defaultValue).
usage:
local units = settings.getValue('uiUnitLength', 'metric')
local all = settings.getValues()
notes: Values are cached (valuesCache); invalidateCache() (alias refresh, settingsChanged) must be called after a setting change to re-read the files. This module is read-only: it writes no file.

Value priority order: defaults (modified by units preset, platform, internal values) < /settings/cloud/settings.json < /settings/settings.json (local). Obsolete/renamed names are converted by upgradeSetting (deprecated.json), with logging on the GE side only.
If a C++ table CppSettings exists and the type of the Lua value differs from the C++ type, the value is ignored with an error in the log.

The 'persona' settings (personaScopedSettings: defaultGearboxBehavior, autoClutch, autoThrottle, spawnVehicleIgnitionLevel, playerCharacterFace) can have a per-persona value stored in /settings/persona-settings.tmp.json; getValue/getPersonaValue consult persona (id or table with an id field) there.
Units preset according to getOSLanguage: US region or 'en' language without a region -> imperial; GB/UK -> british; otherwise metric; applied to the defaults uiUnits*, uiUnitLength, etc.
Peculiarity: if the UI is in simple menu mode (Engine.UI.isSimpleMenu), the default of uiContentScale is 1.05.
The M.path* paths are not functions but configuration fields (e.g. M.pathLocal = '/settings/settings.json'); M.defaults, M.deprecated, M.defaultValues are working tables.

pathInternal.desc: '/settings/not-shipping.internal.json' (internal values, read outside the shipping build)

defaults.desc: setting definitions read from defaults.json; each entry is an array whose [2] is the default value

personaScopedSettings.desc: settings that can have a per-persona value

internalValues.desc: values read from not-shipping.internal.json (exists only outside shipping and if the file exists)

getValue.desc: Returns the value of the setting `key` (defaults/cloud/local merge), or defaultValue if it is nil; then applies the persona value if applicable (if key is in personaScopedSettings and a persona is provided).

defaultValue.desc: fallback value if the setting does not exist

persona.desc: persona (or its id) for per-persona settings

getValues.desc: Returns the complete table of merged settings (cached). Do not modify the returned table (it is the cache).

getPersonaValue.desc: Value of a per-persona setting. If key is not a 'persona' setting or if there is no persona, returns fallbackValue; otherwise the value stored for this persona, or failing that the first fallbackValue memorized for this persona and this key.

invalidatePersonaCache.desc: Forgets the per-persona value cache (re-read on next access).

invalidateCache.desc: Forgets the settings and persona settings cache: the next getValue/getValues will re-read the files. Same functions: refresh and settingsChanged (compatibility).

settingsChanged.desc: Alias of invalidateCache, to be called (by the engine or the UI) when settings have just changed.
